name: Devin (Sneaky D)
bio:
Devin, known affectionately as "Sneaky D," is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the nuanced and shadowy world of black and gray ink. At just 23 years old and working out of Triumph Tattoo Company in Georgia, Devin's unparalleled professionalism shines through in every meticulous stroke and shade of their work, ensuring an exceptional experience for every client. With a steady hand and a keen eye for detail, Sneaky D delivers tattoos that are both artistically breathtaking and timelessly elegant.
